description: Threaded comments on cells of the Svelte 5 data grid with @-mentions. Right-click a cell and choose Add comment to open an editor below the grid; a corner triangle marks cells with active threads, typing @ opens a fuzzy picker over the team list and inserts a chip, threads can be resolved, and mentioned users get a badge. Storage goes through a commentsAdapter, wired here to an in-memory map with the same contract a REST or WebSocket adapter would use.

faq.question: How is the comment indicator drawn?
faq.answer: The cell snippet adds a class when the cell has a thread, and CSS paints a corner triangle with a pseudo-element. There is no overlay layer to keep in sync with scrolling.

faq.question: How does the @-mention picker place the chip?
faq.answer: The editor watches the textarea's selectionStart; when @ is typed it opens a fuzzy search over the team and inserts the chosen name at that position.

faq.question: How would I persist comments?
faq.answer: Keep the same shape as the demo's local adapter, functions that add a comment and resolve a thread against a map keyed by cell, and back them with your API. A remote adapter would call fetch or push over a socket; the grid only ever sees the class the snippet adds.
